verdict.rationale: Docs say that once the client library is installed, thrown errors are sent to Honeybadger automatically. Official libraries are evidenced for backend (Ruby gem, Python Oban integration reporting unhandled worker exceptions) and web frontend (JS packages with automatic instrumentation and source-map un-minification). Nothing in the pack shows mobile app SDKs, so only part of the story is covered. Missing for 10: any evidence of official mobile SDKs (iOS/Android/React Native/Flutter), a documented list of supported platforms, and independent hands-on corroboration of automatic uncaught-error capture.
